hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: State is (house_idx, target_neighborhoods, prev_color). Track minimum cost to paint houses from house_idx to m - 1.

hints.title: Neighborhood Formation
hints.text: When choosing color c for house i, if c does not equal prev_color, neighborhood count decreases by 1.

hints.title: Already Painted vs Unpainted
hints.text: If houses[i] is greater than 0, color is fixed and cost is 0. If houses[i] is 0, try all colors 1 to n adding cost[i][c - 1].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n^m colorings without memoization is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: State space M x Target x N with N color choices per transition runs within limits for M, N <= 100.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles neighborhood increment when prev_color != new_color and respects pre-painted houses.
